Instructions for Use
Device description: The Meridian Peripheral Stent is a peripheral stent. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 48 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Meridian Peripheral Stent is MR Conditional. A person with the Meridian Peripheral Stent may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Meridian Peripheral Stent
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3.0 T
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 4,000 Gauss/cm
RF Transmit Coil Type There are no Transmit Coil restrictions
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode or First Level Controlled Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 4 W/kg
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 25 mm from the device.
Wait at least 6 weeks after implantation before performing an MRI scan.
